slices.applied_user: Account access case AA{ordinal}: my sign-in is locked.
slices.applied_reply: Use the account recovery flow and reference case AA{ordinal} if support is needed.
slices.capstone_user: Access request CA{ordinal}: the account cannot sign in.
slices.capstone_reply: Start account recovery and keep reference CA{ordinal}.

slices.applied_user: Billing case BR{ordinal}: I need the refund status.
slices.applied_reply: Check the refund settlement record and reference BR{ordinal} with billing support.
slices.capstone_user: Refund request CB{ordinal}: the credit is not visible.
slices.capstone_reply: Check the settlement record and keep reference CB{ordinal}.

slices.applied_user: Order case OS{ordinal}: where is my parcel?
slices.applied_reply: Open the carrier tracking record for OS{ordinal} and review its latest scan.
slices.capstone_user: Delivery request CO{ordinal}: the parcel has not arrived.
slices.capstone_reply: Review the carrier trace and keep reference CO{ordinal}.

slices.applied_user: Password case PR{ordinal}: my reset link expired.
slices.applied_reply: Request one fresh password-reset link for PR{ordinal} and discard the expired link.
slices.capstone_user: Reset request CP{ordinal}: the recovery link is expired.
slices.capstone_reply: Request a fresh recovery link and discard CP{ordinal}'s expired link.

slices.applied_user: Product case PI{ordinal}: which plan includes exports?
slices.applied_reply: Consult the current plan comparison for PI{ordinal} before choosing a plan.
slices.capstone_user: Plan request CI{ordinal}: I need export availability.
slices.capstone_reply: Check the current plan comparison for CI{ordinal}.

slices.applied_user: Technical case TI{ordinal}: the app closes at launch.
slices.applied_reply: Collect the app version and sanitized launch log for TI{ordinal}.
slices.capstone_user: App request CT{ordinal}: launch closes immediately.
slices.capstone_reply: Collect the version and sanitized launch log for CT{ordinal}.

instruction_sets.evaluation_serialization: expected.response is the exact two-line assistant content

documents.text: Account recovery uses the recovery page. Verify identity before changing an account email.
Refund status appears in the billing settlement record. Pending refunds include a settlement reference.
Password reset links expire after use. Request one fresh reset link and discard the old link.
Order tracking shows carrier scans. A parcel without a recent scan can receive a carrier trace.
Sign-in security codes depend on an accurate device clock. Synchronize the clock before retrying.
Invoices list service lines and totals. A duplicate service line should be sent to billing review.
Application launch failures need the app version and a sanitized launch log.
Plan comparisons describe export availability and current product limits.
